note: The reported symptom is 'will crash DXC rather than emitting an error message', so the symptom is an INTERNAL FAILURE. `is_internal_failure` combines internal-failure statuses with a build-agnostic `(?:llvm::)?cast<X>() argument` marker for the releases that flatten DXC_E_LLVM_CAST_ERROR to ordinary E_FAIL. That combination is required: the same defect appears as a trapped/thrown assert (0x80000003 / 0xE0000001) in an assert-enabled Debug build, an access violation (0xC0000005) with or without text in old Release builds, 0x80AA001D in intermediate releases, and E_FAIL plus the cast marker in newer releases. A text-only predicate would miss the silent access violations; a status-only predicate would invent a fix when the HRESULT became E_FAIL. Equally important is what this predicate does NOT match: an ordinary diagnosed error exits E_FAIL (0x80004005) without the internal marker and is not an internal failure, which matters here because 'emit an error instead of crashing' is exactly the shape a fix for this issue would take -- a nonzero-exit predicate would have reported the fix as the bug. CONTROL: control-initialised.hlsl is the identical shader with 'uint index = 0;', run through the same command with --expect no-match (see variant-control-initialised-main-debug.txt); it compiles cleanly, so the predicate discriminates on the uninitialised index rather than on the shader.
